t: You're at St Andrew Undershaft, a Church of England church on St Mary Axe in the City of London. It's a rare City church that survived both the Great Fire and the Blitz. Several notable people are buried here. They include the Flemish painter Steven van der Meulen, who worked at the Tudor court, and Augustine Ryther, an engraver who engraved some of Christopher Saxton's county maps and made scientific instruments. Sir John Dethick, Lord Mayor of London in 1656, lies here too, as does Henry Man, a sixteenth-century Bishop of Sodor and Man.
